## Checklist

- [ ] The complete test suite passes locally.
- [ ] New or changed physics has targeted tests and documented assumptions.
- [ ] Units, sign conventions, parameter provenance, and numerical tolerances are explicit.
- [ ] Public API changes and compatibility implications are documented.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where required.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No generated caches, confidential data, or large unintended artifacts are included.
